Use case: identity-preserve. Production whole-figure PIXEL ART walking sprite sheet for an established native64 square-grid roguelike.
Input 1 is the EXACT APPEARANCE, PROPORTION and MATERIAL COLOR master. Input 2 is another cultist used ONLY as the accepted MOVEMENT guide and camera. Do not copy his different face, clothes or equipment.
Redraw only locomotion. Preserve the original head/hood and clothing proportions, stance height, weapon sizes, equipment handedness and all colors. Keep deep charcoal shadows, muted burgundy/crimson cloth, matte brown leather and dull metals. NO whitening, color brightening, new specular highlights, added rim light or automatic glow. The same game lighting applies at rest and during movement.
Layout: EXACTLY 3 equal columns x 3 equal rows, row-major. Eight DISTINCT walking poses in cells 1–8, ninth relaxed idle. Every figure complete including hood apex, staff tip or shield, hands and boots. Generous transparent margins, NO clipping, inter-cell overlap, text or grid. Identical figure scale, camera and rigid proportions in every cell.
Walking: two alternating steps at 400ms per step / 800ms per full cycle. 1 left foot reaches contact with right trailing; 2 weight settles over left foot; 3 right passes closely below hips with LOW knee lift; 4 right reaches next contact; 5 opposite/right contact; 6 settles over right; 7 left passes closely underneath hips; 8 left reaches contact ready to repeat 1. Eight distinct meaningful poses. Compact normal forward/back stride, no lateral leg splaying, high knees, skating or dancing. Robe hem moves subtly and exposes the alternately planted boots, allowing the step to read; do not hide every foot under a long robe. Head, torso, shoulders, arms and equipment move coherently with minimal bob. No detached head, sheared bands or grafted legs.
Exact master's native game pixel-art finish: deliberate crisp pixel clusters and readable contours for a roughly 60px high figure. NOT smooth HD painting, 3D, blur, grain, airbrush or glossy recolor.
Background genuinely transparent alpha ZERO including gaps between limbs and objects. No floor, cast shadow, matte, checkerboard, border, text, labels or watermark.
Subject: Exact cultist in identity reference: a dark charcoal hood edged in burgundy red, small ivory featureless mask inside the dark hood, charcoal knee-length robe with dark red scarf/chest cloth and vertical red front panel, brown leather belt and brown boots. He grips ONE thin dark upright staff in his ANATOMICAL LEFT hand: SCREEN RIGHT from front, SCREEN LEFT from back. Staff has a SMALL muted violet jewel at its tip, not a bright glowing orb. Staff tip stays just BELOW the hood apex, same relative height as reference. Anatomical right hand remains an empty gloved hand near the chest. No new weapon, armor or cloak redesign. The staff remains straight, correctly gripped and firmly connected to the left hand throughout all poses.
Direction: True FRONT view walking SOUTH/DOWN toward viewer, same slightly elevated native projection throughout all eight poses.
